definitions.scope: 2026, final parsed games between covered teams
definitions.garbage_time: Every new metric is dual-surfaced, ranked separately with eligibility/rank-movement checks

pressure_to_sack_rate.definition: Sacks / dropbacks with a sack or recorded hurry; unique plays, not summed defender credits.

ball_disruption_rate.definition: Pass attempts with a named PBU or interception / attempts. A play with both counts once; sacks are not attempts.

epa_allowed.definition: Offensive EPA allowed per dropback with numeric EPA in this matched subset; missing EPA is excluded, never zero-filled.

success_allowed.definition: Offensive down-and-distance successes / dropbacks with a recorded boolean success verdict in this matched subset.

completion_rate.definition: Completions / attempts with a known completion/interception verdict in this matched subset; sacks and unknown outcomes excluded.

yards_per_attempt.definition: Credited completion yards / pass attempts with known result/yardage; known incompletions contribute zero, missing completion yardage is excluded.

explosive_20_rate.definition: Completed passes gaining 20+ credited yards / attempts with known result/yardage; not air-yard depth.

nonconverting_completion_rate.definition: Completions that did not convert the down / completions, using downs.converted_down; not a physical catch-location, tackle-efficiency or coverage grade.

yac_per_charted_completion.definition: Credited yards minus charted air yards / charted completions in this matched subset; uncharted catches are not zero YAC.

notes: success: our down-and-distance definition (50% of the distance on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, 100% on 3rd/4th), not positive EPA. The glossary's 'positive EPA' would differ on individual plays.
explosive: yardage-based -- a 12+ yard run or a 16+ yard pass play (ruled 2026-09-15) -- not the EPA thresholds (2.4 pass / 1.8 rush) in the glossary.
explosiveness: mean EPA on successful plays, as the glossary says.

adj_epa_per_play: league mean plus the team's offensive term from the opponent-adjusted ridge (per-game EPA/play, weighted by plays); on the defense side, EPA/play allowed against an average offense. Fitted inside the 18-team league, so not comparable to an FBS adjusted EPA.

power run: 3rd/4th down, 2 or fewer to go, a carry; power_success = converted. Line yards are the engine's per-carry credit (losses x1.2, 0-4 yards x1, 5-10 x0.5, beyond 10 none). second_level_yards = the 5-10 yard band per carry; open_field_yards = yards beyond 10 per carry.
scoring opportunity: a drive with a snap at or inside the opponent 40.

havoc rate: plays with a TFL, sack, forced fumble, pass defensed or interception / plays. havoc_front_seven / havoc_defensive_back: havoc plays credited to a DL/LB or DB (by roster position) / plays; a play credited to both counts in both.
average_start: yards from the offense's own goal line. net_field_position on the offense side is this team's average start minus its opponents'; on the defense side, the reverse.
turnover_luck: actual minus expected turnovers -- offense side committed, defense side forced.
Every rate is counted over the season's plays and divided once. Games with play-by-play only (games between two of the 18).

f10_*: 1st & 10 snaps; run rate = runs / (runs + dropbacks). qb_share_*: carries and rush yards by a rostered QB or anyone with 10+ pass attempts that season, over the same carries as success_rate_rush (offense only; null on defense). rush_success_*_half: regulation halves, overtime in neither.

Down & distance: attempts and conversions are the box score's (src/helpers/downs.py). A snap wiped by a foul replays the down and is neither; a turnover or a failed go that leaves a 1st down is not a conversion. third_short = 1-3 to go, third_long = 7+. fourth_down_go_rate = goes / (goes + punts + field goals), offense only.
plays_20_plus / 25 / 40: scrimmage plays by credited yards (defense: allowed), garbage time included.

pressure_rate: dropbacks with a sack or a named QB hurry / dropbacks (offense: allowed, defense: made); hurry_rate: the hurries without a sack. Hurries are only as complete as the stat crew's charting, so compare them with care across opponents. Garbage time included.

stop_rate: carries for 0-2 yards / carries; rush_tfl_rate: carries for a loss / carries (the season versions of the per-game rushing.stopRate / tflRate in games_{season}.json). The *_competitive versions drop garbage-time snaps (play_filters.is_garbage_time); both ship (house garbage-time rule).

availability.note: A block ships only when the feed states its field (depth and direction, rush lane, havoc placement) on at least 80% of the season's plays; below that the arrays are empty and `coverage` says how much there was.

spatial.air_yac_definition: pass_grid `air_yards` / `yac`: on completions only. Air yards = line of scrimmage to the catch spot; yac = the completion's yards minus its air yards (a catch behind the line has negative air yards and more yac than yards). air_yards + yac = yards over the `split_completions` that carry a catch spot. Garbage time included, like the rest of the grid.
spatial.defense_players_definition: Defense side `players`: defenders credited with a play on a pass to this cell -- a break-up, an interception, or the tackle on the reception -- counted in `targets`. Not a coverage assignment.
spatial.havoc_placement: Break-up: where the pass was thrown. TFL: the run's lane. Sack, and a hurry with no throw: middle. Forced fumble: its play's lane. Interception: unplaceable (the feed gives a yardline, not a side) -- counted in `unattributed.havoc`.
